Before you drive

Flying is weather- and crew-dependent.

Contact the club before making a special trip. A quiet ramp can mean delayed conditions or activity staged elsewhere on the field.

Weather tools →Field media →

Respect the operating area

Airports have invisible boundaries.

  • Check in before entering operating areas.
  • Never cross a runway, taxiway, tow rope, or launch path without explicit direction.
  • Keep children and pets under close control.
  • Stay clear of propellers—even when an engine appears stopped.
  • Follow field-crew directions immediately and ask before touching aircraft.

Bring closed-toe shoes, water, sun protection, flexible layers, and patience. For an emergency, call 911.
